install_apk: build a python module to install an Android APK on a connected device using the AdbCallParser class
start_activity: create a python script to start a specific Android activity on a connected device via AdbCallParser
tap_screen: build a python module to tap the Android device screen at given x and y coordinates using AdbCallParser
input_text: create a python script to type text input on an Android device using the AdbCallParser input_text method
force_stop_app: build a python module to force stop a running Android application by package name using AdbCallParser
